goal: Break up the monolithic P2P message dispatch function into discrete helper subroutines
Makes message dispatching and lock scopes easier to navigate and analyze for maintainers
agreement: Substantive support with all raised issues resolved
Follows the pattern of similar message-processing cleanups (w0xlt)
Concept approval because named helpers simplify navigation and review (hodlinator)
Previous objections regarding backport conflicts and logging were addressed (maflcko)
